items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: we took Vidal Bolado, our conga player, to Miami where there was Mangual, Vidal, Uba, Andino and Rene Hernandez.

ctx.x: You already had a conga at that time, before Chano came here?
Ah, yes. Vidal Bolado, he left the band to go with Stan Kenton. Vidal Bolado was the conga player.....
